title: EdgeErased
description:
`edge_erased` — one edge of an estate erased: a folded edge homed in a context of the person's
estate, every prior value of its free text on its own trail redacted to the sentinels. One
event per edge, category `admin`, NULL-anchored. It projects `kb_event_field_redactions` rows
under the `edge` authority, whose subject check reads the folded edge's home against
`_erasure_estate_contexts(estate_of)`.

Keyed `subject_table` (`kb_edges`) / `subject_id`, never `edge_id`, and the person by
`estate_of`, never `owner`: no key is a trail join-key shape (`edge_id`, `resource_id`,
`owner`, `source`, `target`, `block_id`), and `_edge_erasure_trail_scope` joins on `edge_id`
and `owner`. Paths only, never values: the record of a redaction must not carry what was
redacted.

actor.description: The acting system admin. `None` only where no actor exists to name.

estate_of.description: The person whose estate homes the edge.

folded.description:
True when the act folded the edge itself, by a `relationship_folded` appended before this
event in the act's transaction; false when the edge was already folded. The act always
writes it; a reader takes an absent value as false.

redacted_fields.description: The ledger paths this act redacted to their sentinels, in the shape `resource_erased` uses.

AnchorTable.description: A polymorphic anchor/endpoint reference. Serializes table names exactly as the DDL spells them.

RedactedEventFields.description:
The ledger paths of one event: redacted (`redacted_fields`) or named-and-unreached
(`ledger_remainder`). ONE shape for both, so the cut-2 completion pass derives what it redacts
from what cut 1 recorded without translating (resource erasure spec D12). The event is keyed
`event`, never `event_id` — no trail join-key shape rides an admin payload (D1). Paths only,
never values: the record of a redaction must not carry what was redacted.

paths.description: JSON paths within that event's `payload` (or `metadata`), e.g. `title`, `origin_uri`.
